1.title: Orientation + GDG x Hacktoberfest HF 2026
1.about:
Join the official Orientation of Google Developer Groups (GDG) on Campus Lokmanya Tilak College of Engineering in collaboration with Hacktoberfest 2026!

Guest Speakers:
• Shankar Warang (Co-founder & Investor @Nothing, Tychee Labs & GRYD)
• Anurag Pandey (Maintainer & Contributor @IPFS-Meshkit)

Learn how to contribute to Open Source, get mentorship on Git/GitHub, build impactful projects, and discover how to win exclusive Devcon passes, stickers, badges, and limited-edition tech merchandise. Free entry for all LTCE students!

2.title: Poster Making & Presentation Competition: Emerging Tech for Sustainability
2.about:
Lokmanya Tilak College of Engineering (An Autonomous Institute Affiliated to University of Mumbai) - Institution Innovation Council (IIC) in collaboration with AIMSA presents the Annual Poster Making and Presentation Competition.

Theme: "Emerging Technology Integration for Environment and Sustainability"

Explore how AI, IoT, Robotics, Drones, Renewable Energy, Smart Systems & Data Analytics can drive a sustainable future.

Coordinators:
• Student Coordinators: Bhavishya Chauhan, Haresh Chavan (AIMSA), Vishal Gupta, Mitali Joshi (IIC)
• Faculty Coordinators: Prof. Arti Ochani, Prof. Megha Khadke, Prof. Ujjwala Pandharkar
• Leadership: Dr. Snehal Junnarkar (IIC Convener), Dr. Sheeba P.S (IIC VP), Dr. Chaitrali Chaudhari (HOD CSE AI&ML), Dr. Subhash Shinde (Principal & IIC President).

Prizes and Certificates of Merit for Top 3 Presenters!

3.title: Rookery Hackathon - Keep Building!
3.venue: Lokmanya Tilak College of Engineering Campus
3.about: Department of CSE AI & ML presents ROOKERY HACKATHON - KEEP BUILDING! Got an idea? Build anything. Get funded. Sell it after. Join us for an 8-hour open innovation hackathon with NO fixed problem statement: just your idea, your team, and the freedom to build. Highlights: • $20-$30 seed funding per team • 1st Place Prize + Cash Prizes for Top 3 • $500 worth of AI credits • Winning projects can go live on Dropcode and reach real users! Faculty & Leadership: • Dr. Chaitrali Chaudhari (HOD CSE-AIML) • Dr. Subhash Shinde (Principal) • Student Coordinators: Shreyash Pandey, Aditya Pandey (AIMSA Student Team) Online registration portal: https://Rookery.dropcode.in ↗

4.title: Hands-on Group Discussion Practice Workshop
4.about:
Training & Placement Session Under IQAC: Hands-on Group Discussion Practice Workshop.

Keynote Trainer: Dr. Rashmi Rani (M.A., MPhil, PhD)

Step in. Speak up. Stand out! Remember our GD Orientation Session? You learned the rules, strategies & techniques - now it is time to PUT THEM INTO PRACTICE!

Session Highlights:
• Participate in live GD simulations
• Apply learned evaluation strategies
• Practice teamwork & active listening
• Build communication & interview confidence
• Receive personalized feedback from panel mentors

Coordinators & Leadership:
• Mr. Hemant More (Assistant TPO)
• Dr. Prerana Shrivastava (Training & Placement Officer)
• Dr. Subhash K. Shinde (Principal)

5.title: Orientation on Project Deep Blue Season 12
5.about:
The Institution Innovation Council (IIC) of Lokmanya Tilak College of Engineering cordially invites students to attend the official orientation of Project Deep Blue - Season 12 (A Mastek initiative).

Speaker: Mr. Swapnil Pawar (Senior Executive PMO, Mastek Ltd.)

Project Deep Blue empowers engineering students to solve real-world social and technological challenges through cutting-edge software solutions with direct mentorship from Mastek industry leaders.

Leadership & Organization:

• Faculty Coordinators: Prof. Ujjwala Pandharkar, Dr. Snehal Junnarkar
• Convener: Dr. Nimisha Shirbhate
